preconditions.expression: len(s) == n - 2 and all(c in 'LR' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must have a length of n-2 and consist only of 'L' and 'R' characters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(stdout.split()) == n and all(1 <= int(p) <= n for p in stdout.split()))
postconditions.description: If no valid permutation exists, output -1; otherwise, output a permutation of n distinct integers.

postconditions.expression: all(c == 'L' if is_left_turn(points[p[i-1]-1], points[p[i]-1], points[p[i+1]-1]) else c == 'R' for i in range(1, n-1))
postconditions.description: The output permutation must satisfy the winding condition specified by the string s.
